messages:
Anya P: Heads-up: planning a cross-region quiesce + schema migration for `accounts.last_seen_v2` tonight 02:00 UTC. This is an ADD COLUMN + opportunistic backfill that will run on each shard. Expect short-lived write stalls during quiesce handshake. I'll coordinate rollback if needed.

Ravi S: Copy. Which services should be pinned and for how long?

Anya P: Pin: account-service and webapp to `v5.2.0` for a 45m window (02:00-02:45). Workers will start backfill after quiesce ack from all regions.

Nina T: I'll own the quiesce handshake. Plan: send quiesce signal to regions in order (us-east1 -> eu-west1 -> ap-south1), wait for graceful drain (<30s), then start regional backfill. If any region fails drain in >120s, we abort and roll back.

deploybot: Deploybot: scheduled migration job queued at 3100124400. Canary id: cb-9912. Notifying #eng-releases.

ops-bot: NOTE: Remember to attach migration SQL artifact and migration_sha to the deploy note.

Ravi S: I'll upload SQL to releases: s3://releases/3100123999/add_last_seen_v2.sql and set `migration_sha=9b2d1f`.

Anya P: Rollback criteria (short):
1) Any region reports >5% error increase in account-service over 15m.
2) Persistent row lock contention where `SELECT count(*) FROM pg_locks WHERE granted AND mode ~ 'RowExclusive'` > 8 for >3m.
3) Backfill worker rate causes p99 write lat > 2s for 10m.

Nina T: Monitoring hooks added:
- Lock alert: triggers on >8 RowExclusive for 180s -> posts to #eng-oncall and auto-pings @Ravi S and @Anya P.
- Quiesce timeout: if a region doesn't ack drain in 120s, ops-bot will post emergency.

Ravi S: Rollback runbook (condensed):
```
1) Cancel backfill jobs: /svcctl backfill last_seen_v2 cancel --all
2) Re-open writes: POST /admin/flags/last_seen_v2_write false
3) If schema needs reversal: ALTER TABLE accounts DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS last_seen_v2;
4) Redeploy pinned services to previous tag (account-service v5.1.8)
```

Anya P: We'll test the revert path in staging at 23:00 UTC — please join if you can.

deploybot: Canary cb-9912 started at 3100124400. Logs: https://deploys/redwood/cb-9912.

Nina T: us-east1 quiesce ack in 18s. eu-west1 ack in 22s. ap-south1 ack pending (30s elapsed).

ops-bot: ap-south1: high connection churn observed - investigating.

Nina T: ap-south1 ack received at 02:03. All regions quiesced. Starting regional backfills sequentially.

Ravi S: Backfill workers started in us-east1. Rate limiter set to 500 qps, concurrency=6.

Anya P: Reminder: hold auto-promote for 20m after canary green. We want to validate regional backfills and metrics.

deploybot: Canary cb-9912: healthy at 3100124525. Holding auto-promote per request.

Nina T: Lock-watch: us-east1 RowExclusive spikes to 9 for 3m -> alert posted. Investigating hot queries.

Ravi S: Investigating. Found a long-running bulk write job from a third-party batch (pid 81234). Cancelling 81234 now.

Anya P: After cancelling, lock count dropped to 3. Good catch.

deploybot: Backfill progress: us-east1 40% complete, eu-west1 0% (queued), ap-south1 queued.

Nina T: Observability note: p95 write lat rose 200ms briefly during the cancellation window, now back to baseline.

Ravi S: Given the transient nature and resolved locks, I'm comfortable to approve promote in +10m if no other issues.

Anya P: Approve from infra side. Proceeding to promote at +10m if green.

deploybot: Promotion started: cb-9912 -> prod at 3100124570.

ops-bot: Post-promotion: keep lock-watch for 30m and don't disable quiesce alerts.

Nina T: Post-deploy checks: backfill completed in us-east1, eu-west1 at 70%, ap-south1 at 60%. No deadlocks seen.

Ravi S: Metrics steady. No error spike. Backfills finishing gradually; rate limits prevented overload.

Anya P: Confirming feature flag `last_seen_v2_write` toggled to true for writes.

deploybot: Deploy summary: migration_sha=9b2d1f, canary=cb-9912, promoted at 3100124570. Artifacts: s3://releases/3100123999/add_last_seen_v2.sql

Nina T: Closing watch in 30m. Thanks everyone for quick responses.

Ravi S: Added release note: "accounts.last_seen_v2 column added; cross-region quiesce + staged backfill performed; pinned services during window."

Anya P: Thread archived and logs stored at s3://deploy-archive/3100123999/ - include the rollback runbook in the release doc.
